overloads.semanticRole: Return a deep copy of object, optionally resolving any pointer values into their evaluated targets during the copy (resolvePtrs).

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the second parameter is a plain Boolean (or omitted); mutually exclusive with the option/groupWith syntax.

overloads.semanticRole: Return a deep copy of object with fine-grained control via option (bitwise ck constants: ck shared to return a shared object, ck resolve pointers to resolve pointers before copying), optionally grouped into an existing shared object/collection's shared group via groupWith.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the second parameter is an Integer options bitfield rather than a plain Boolean; groupWith is only meaningful together with this syntax.

constraints: If object contains pointer values, the copy keeps them as-is by default (not evaluated) unless pointer resolution is requested via resolvePtrs (overload 1) or the ck resolve pointers option (overload 2).
